body:
`remark-gfm` hard-codes `disabled` on the `<input>` it emits for task-list checkboxes. DOM-level change events **don't fire on disabled inputs**, so our controlled `TaskCheckbox` never received `onChange` → state never flipped → storage write never happened, even though the input appeared interactive because I'd styled it.

Fix: destructure `disabled` off the props spread in `TaskCheckbox` and drop it on the floor. One line, massive behavioral difference.
